verdict.rationale: WorkOS provides machine-to-machine (M2M) application credentials for programmatic API access (workos-docs-32) and RBAC with custom roles/scoped permissions (workos-docs-3, workos-docs-22, workos-supp-rbac-jwt), which are the building blocks for giving an agent a distinct, narrowly-scoped machine identity rather than sharing a human's login. The AuthKit MCP integration (workos-docs-8, workos-docs-27, workos-probe-4) further shows agent-specific OAuth-gated access to WorkOS resources. However, there is no explicit documentation of per-agent identity issuance workflows or instant revocation mechanics tailored to AI agents specifically. Missing for 10: explicit 'instant revocation' feature/API for machine credentials, documented per-agent scoping workflow distinct from human RBAC, and independent evidence of this being used for AI-agent identity in practice.
